summary: CVC-PE Global Private Equity Fund, LP filed an 8-K reporting a routine continuous private offering of unregistered limited partnership units. On September 1, 2026, the Fund sold 399,864 Class R-S Units for $49,232,710 and 247,835 Class R-I Units for $30,659,026, aggregating roughly $79.9 million, priced at the August 31, 2026 Transactional NAV per Unit: $123.12 for Class R-S, $123.71 for Class R-I, Class C $128.30 and Class G $123.71. Sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D; some flowed through a parallel TE vehicle for tax-exempt and non-U.S. investors. No special-situation event is present.
